authorization: User paused the broad44m experiment and requested the same sampling count compressed within20m radius,then retraining. Preserve previously authorized40m height,30deg FOV,2m success radius and10m/20m tests.

learning.split_generator: isolated CPU torch.randperm seeded10; group all8 headings together
learning.collection_constraint: Only the original bee generator with5 turns and147 positions,uniformly compressed into20m radius; no additional positions,near-home grid or old images

preprocessing.rotation: Train only: online uniform[0,360) image rotation with coupled body-vector labels; fixed mask follows rotation
preprocessing.evaluation: Same fixed circle inside exported model; no random rotation

initialization: Fresh seeded Xavier initialization; no previous model weights or optimizer state,including epoch600 or near-data models
selection: Complete600 epochs,select the lowest full-validation physical component MSE with earlier epoch breaking ties; freeze deployment before navigation. Preserve final600 separately. No selection using navigation or test images.

navigation.success_definition: Terminate at an executed action endpoint with simulator-truth horizontal distance<=2m; otherwise fail after50 actions. Seeing home in the image is not the success criterion. Initial success and segment crossing are reported separately.
navigation.supervision: Formal model decisions use RGB and current yaw only. Ground truth scores arrival and checks scene bounds. The rendered oracle is a separately labelled engineering check,not a neural result.

limits: Single scene and seed;147 spiral positions within20m only,and6 independent validation positions. Shorter training vectors can lower absolute MSE mechanically; assess the actual10m/20m navigation results at2m success radius. Radius20m starts lie at the training-center boundary. No training coverage guarantee for trajectories that leave20m. Kinematic navigation,no real-flight dynamics or autonomous home detector.
